About the Kwik-E-Mart

Welcome to The Kwik-E-Mart guild page! Thank you for visiting, and we are glad that you found interest in our page! We are a pre-made guild in Dungeon Runners before Chunk 4 releases ACTUAL guilds. We plan on growing big and strong, and treating all our members with courtesy and the almost enough respect to make you happy. We are as you suspected a little overpriced guild. Our motto is famous. (buy one get the other for twice the price) and that MIGHT apply to this guild. Our Seller (ApuNahasapemapetilon) will be trading purples and rainbows.

If you have any questions, or you are interested in joining, Oneshotkillz, contact him ingame on the usual World 1.
